column1: # THE REAL SIDE's record bands (2026-10-11, item 60, the TIPS-ladder consumer's request): sixteen
# graded rows in six groups, each read on a public-domain record and resampled in one-year blocks
# of its own cadence (252 sessions for a daily record, FIVE YEARS of months for a monthly one: a
# year-over-year rate straddles a join in every month of a twelve-month block, and the 1970s regime
# that makes the record's year-over-year sd outlasts one), each group under its own joint band at
# its share of the mode's sixteen rows (`-of 16`, alpha 0.10). No licensed series: the TIPS index a
# consumer would grade a fund on is replaced by a par TIPS built from FRED's DFII10 and CPI-U.
# THE ERA RULE: the TIPS records begin in 2003, the model's rates anchor on each set's rate window,
# and the 2003-2026 LEVELS (a real yield of 1.0 against the century's 2.3, a breakeven at the era's
# target, the sd of each level over one secular hump) are that era's, not a statistic a 1954-2026
# world can hold; they are REPORTED beside the model's, and the graded rows are era-free: each
# month-end series' month-to-month change, the leg's volatility, depth and correlations, and the
# ex-post real rate over the rate's own window. THE CPI AND REAL-RATE ROWS FOLLOW THE SET'S RATE
# WINDOW: the S&P set's on 1954-2026 (DFF 1954-2026), the Nasdaq set's on 1999-2026 (DFF 1999-2026):
# a 2.1% policy rate under 1954-2026's 3.5% inflation is a real rate near -1, which no dial can
# hold at the 71-year record's +1.1; on its own era the Nasdaq's rows read 2.57% inflation, a
# year-over-year sd of 1.72 and an ex-post real rate of -0.47 (sd 2.58). THE S&P SET REPORTS THE
# BREAKEVEN'S THREE ROWS AND THE LEG'S CORRELATION WITH THE NOMINAL LEG (its era rows): the
# year-over-year rate's persistence at twelve months is 0.73 on 1954-2026 against the TIPS era's
# 0.26 (`cpipersist-2026-10-12.tsv`), and a market whose inflation regimes last moves its
# breakeven with the prints as the era's market did not; the Nasdaq set, on 1999-2026, grades them.
#   CPI (`cpi_readings`, CPI-U 1954-01..2026-08, monthly log changes; CPIAUCSL):
#     cpi mean %/yr           the log change a year, percent
#     cpi yoy sd pp           sd of the year-over-year rate in simple percent
#     cpi monthly sd pp       sd of the month-to-month log change, percent: what an indexation lag reads
#     cpi 4%+ share %         months at or above 4%: eleven spells, median 6 months, longest 117 (1973-82)
#     the year-over-year persistence at 12 months (0.7304 on 1954-2026, 0.2581 on 1999-2026) is
#     graded as a single-history row in `cpipersist-2026-10-12.tsv`: the statistic straddles a
#     block join in every pair, so it cannot be banded here
#     reported, not graded: the negative-year-over-year share 2.56% (1954-2026 holds too little
#     deflation to band: its own resamples admit none), spell median 6, max 117
#   CPI, THE CENTURY (`cpi_century_readings`, CPI-U not seasonally adjusted 1913-01..2026-08, read
#     whole; CPIAUCNS, the longest public record):
#     cpi deflation share % (century)  months whose year-over-year rate is below zero: 1921-23,
#                             unchanged rounded prices is zero, not deflation: below -1e-9)
#     cpi 4%+ spells per century  how often a 4%+ spell STARTS per hundred years (22 in 113): the
#                             row that tells one spell of 300 months from ten of thirty
#   REAL YIELD (`real_yield_readings`, DFII10 month ends 2003-01-31..2026-07-31; the resamples are of
#     the month-to-month changes, since a resample of the levels puts a jump at every block join):
#     real yield monthly change sd pp  sd of the month-end to month-end change: a random walk within
#                             the year (the 12-month change's sd is 0.96 of sqrt(12) times it),
#                             mean reversion over years
#     reported: level 0.9805, sd 1.0124, persistence at 12 months 0.7311, min -1.16 (Jul 2021),
#     max 3.14 (Oct 2008); the level less the ex-post real rate over their 271 common months 1.789
#   BREAKEVEN (`breakeven_readings`, T10YIE month ends, the same window, resampled the same way):
#     breakeven monthly change sd pp  how far the market's ten-year breakeven moves in a month
#                             (the record's slope on the year-over-year rate's change is 0.11)
#     breakeven own change sd pp  the sd of that change's residual on the year-over-year rate's
#                             change at the same month ends (CPI-U; a month the CPI lacks, October
#                             2025, leaves that pair out): nine tenths of the move is the
#                             breakeven's own (their correlation 0.30), a premium over the
#                             expectation, which an expectation moving with the prints cannot
#                             carry at any slope; the pairs are resampled together
#     breakeven vs yield corr monthly  the correlation of that change with the DGS10 month-end
#                             change (the same month ends): 0.51, with the real yield's change
#                             -0.17, so half of the breakeven's move is expected-inflation news
#                             the nominal yield carries and the real yield does not; a premium
#                             the real yield carries whole reads about 0.15 (`-brknominal`)
#     reported: level 2.1088, sd 0.3943, lowest 0.11 (Dec 2008)
#   TIPS (`tips_readings`, a 10-year par TIPS rebought at every DFII10 observation, its REAL price return,
#     the DGS10 par bond and Ken French's daily market (Mkt-RF + RF) on the 5888 sessions all three trade,
#     2003-01-06..2026-08-03, each compounded across the sessions the others skip):
#     tips vol per duration   annualised RMS of each session's return over the par bond's modified
#                             duration at the prior real yield, percent per year of duration
#     tips depth vs vol       share of sessions more than 10% under the running peak over what the
#                             volatility implies (`0.0397 x vol - 0.0785`), the bond row's reading
#     tips vs bond10 corr     daily correlation with the DGS10 par bond
#     tips vs equity corr monthly  correlation with the market over 21-session months (daily it is -0.11:
#                             flight-to-quality days; the months a ladder's mix is read on make it +0.16)
#     reported: the 2022 real return, Dec 2021 - Oct 2022, -22.87% at the par bond's own duration (about
#     10 at a -1% real yield; -18.9% at duration 8); the consumer's -12% was a fund's nominal 2022 return
#   REAL RATE EX POST (`real_rate_readings`, DFF's monthly mean less the next twelve months' CPI-U
#     inflation, 1954-07..2025-08): mean and sd. No public record of one-year expected inflation exists,
#     so the realised rate is what the model's `realRate` is set against.
# Each row carries the record's reading and its spread over 20,000 moving block resamples. The sets
# share every record but the CPI and real-rate windows. FRED's series and the French market are
# public; the files are not shipped.
# Generated by `rust/src/bin/record_bands.rs -tips` (twin: `jsrc/recordBands.sc -tips`, byte-identical):

#       -nominal DGS10.csv -fred DFF.csv -french F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily.csv -set sp500|nasdaq
